{{short description|French mathematician}}
[[File:Alain-Sol Sznitman.jpeg|thumb|240px|Sznitman in 2005]]
'''Alain-Sol Sznitman''' (born 13 December 1955) is a French and Swiss [[mathematician]] who works as a professor of mathematics at [[ETH Zurich]]. His research concerns [[probability theory]] and [[mathematical physics]].<ref name="cv">[https://ethz.ch/content/dam/ethz/special-interest/math/department/Research/Research_Groups/Sznitman/CV/SznitmanCVoct19.pdf Curriculum vitae], retrieved 2021-03-05.</ref> Within the field of [[percolation theory]], Sznitman introduced the study of random interlacements.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Sznitman |first=Alain-Sol |date=2010 |title=Vacant set of random interlacements and percolation |url=https://annals.math.princeton.edu/2010/171-3/p13 |journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] |language=en-US |volume=171 |issue=3 |pages=2039–2087 |doi=10.4007/annals.2010.171.2039|arxiv=0704.2560 }}</ref>

==Education and career==
Sznitman did his undergraduate studies at the [[École Normale Supérieure]], and earned a Doctorat d'Etat in 1983 from [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]], under the supervision of Jacques Neveu.<ref name="cv"/><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=33055}}</ref> He worked at the [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]] at [[New York University]] beginning in 1983 and was promoted to full professor there in 1990. He moved to ETH Zurich in 1991, and from 1995 to 1999 was director of the [[Institute for Mathematical Research]] at ETH Zurich. He is a [[dual citizen]] of France and Switzerland.<ref name="cv"/>

==Recognition==
In 1991, Sznitman won the [[Rollo Davidson Prize]], given annually to an early-career probabilist, and in 1999 he won the [[Loève Prize|Line and Michel Loève International Prize in Probability]].<ref name="cv"/> He became a [[fellow]] of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1997,<ref name="cv"/> and of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2012.<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2015-01-14.</ref> He was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1998.<ref name="cv"/><ref>{{cite book|author=Sznitman, Alain-Sol|chapter=Brownian motion and random obstacles|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. III|year=1998|pages=301–310|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011587000}}</ref>
